title.zh: 卸载非阿里云主机的云监控插件

descriptions.zh: > 本接口不适用于阿里云主机的云监控插件。卸载阿里云主机的云监控插件的方法，请参见[安装和卸载插件](~~183482~~)。
descriptions.en: > This API operation is not applicable to Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances. To uninstall the agent from an ECS instance, see [Install and uninstall the CloudMonitor agent](~~183482~~).
